REALLY-INSPIRED.Settings.PoolMode.Name: Inspiration Mode
REALLY-INSPIRED.Settings.PoolMode.Hint: Shared: a single inspiration pool for the whole party. Individual: each character has their own counter.
REALLY-INSPIRED.Settings.MaxPerCharacter: Inspiration cap per character. In shared mode, the pool's maximum is this value multiplied by the number of player characters.
REALLY-INSPIRED.Settings.PlayersCanAdjus: If enabled, players can use the +/- buttons on the character sheet. If disabled, only the GM can.
REALLY-INSPIRED.Warning.NoCharacter: You don't have a character assigned to grant inspiration.
REALLY-INSPIRED.Warning.AlreadyMax: {actor} already has the maximum amount of inspiration.
REALLY-INSPIRED.Warning.NoGMForBorrow: Couldn't apply: that character's owner or a GM needs to be connected.
REALLY-INSPIRED.Chat.RerollFlavorSelf: Rerolled by spending their own inspiration.
REALLY-INSPIRED.Chat.RerollFlavorGranted: Rerolled thanks to inspiration granted by {actor}.
REALLY-INSPIRED.Chat.ChooseCharacter.Hin: You control more than one character with inspiration available. Choose which one to spend it from.
REALLY-INSPIRED.Keybind.GrantInspiration: Opens a dialog to grant 1 inspiration to a character.
REALLY-INSPIRED.GrantDialog.Title: Who gets inspiration?
REALLY-INSPIRED.GrantDialog.Hint: Choose the character that receives 1 inspiration.
